category.instructions: Which celestial body rules this activity?

criteria.Mars: Sports, exercise, competition, confrontation, bold new starts.
criteria.Venus: Romance, dating, art, beauty, fashion, socializing, treats.
criteria.Mercury: Communication, writing, emails, short trips, tech, contracts.
criteria.Jupiter: Learning, long travel, games of chance, celebrations.
criteria.Sun: Performance, creative self-expression, being the center of attention.

sensitivity.instructions: Classify this activity's sensitivity. Check for violence or harm to a person or animal (including self-harm) first -- that always wins over every other category. Otherwise pick whichever single category best applies, or 'none' if nothing applies.

criteria.violence_person: Violence, harm, or aggression directed at a person or animal -- including the asker harming themselves (self-harm, suicide, or wanting to end their own life), and eating an animal that isn't ordinary food: a pet or companion animal (cat, dog, rabbit, hamster, horse), a protected or endangered animal (dolphin, whale, panda, ape), or a person. Eating ordinary food animals (chicken, fish, beef, pork, lamb, seafood) is NOT harm. Always pick this over health/safety/legal if it applies.
criteria.safety: A decision about physical safety or risk of injury, not otherwise about violence toward a person, animal, or object.
criteria.legal: A decision with legal consequences: lawsuits, contracts with legal weight, breaking the law, legal advice.
criteria.health: A decision about physical or mental health, medication, medical treatment, surgery, or diagnosis -- not self-harm.
criteria.money: A significant financial decision: investing, borrowing, a loan or mortgage, savings, or debt.
criteria.relationship_ending: A decision about ending a romantic relationship or marriage (breakup, divorce).
criteria.job_quitting: A decision about quitting or resigning from a job.
criteria.violence_object: Violence, force, or destruction directed only at an inanimate object or thing (e.g. smashing a printer) -- never at a person or animal, and not self-harm.
criteria.none: None of the above: an ordinary activity with no special real-life-consequence or safety concern, including eating ordinary food such as chicken, fish, beef, pork, or lamb.
